sources.title: Kosovo Visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Republic of Kosovo embassies platform publishes the current closed short-stay visa-exemption list and the required application procedure for other foreign nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You must apply for a Kosovo visa if you wish to visit or transit through the territory of the Republic of Kosovo.

policies.title: Palestinian ordinary passports: Kosovo advance short-stay visitor visa
policies.summary: Kosovo's current closed visa-exemption list does not include Palestine, and its Foreign Ministry requires other foreign nationals to use the in-person diplomatic or consular visa process before a visit.
conditions: Submit the short-stay visa application in person to the relevant Kosovo diplomatic or consular mission no later than three months before the intended visit. The current official exemption list does not name Palestine, and no listed special-category exemption is inferred here.

This is an advance consular route, not an eVisa or nationality-wide visa-on-arrival route. Passport recognition, mission availability, transit, residence, work, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.
